intent.proves: At least one completed order has moved past its flow's default state.
intent.scope: completed orders excluding quotes, ledger entries and subscription base orders

bindings.reason: search_orders takes a request object and pages; a complete-enumeration handler with this filter is not implemented.

bindings.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM EcomOrders o WHERE o.OrderComplete = 1 AND ISNULL(o.OrderDeleted, 0) = 0 AND ISNULL(o.OrderIsQuote, 0) = 0 AND ISNULL(o.OrderIsLedgerEntry, 0) = 0 AND ISNULL(o.OrderIsRecurringOrderTemplate, 0) = 0 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM EcomOrderStates s WHERE s.OrderStateId = o.OrderStateId AND ISNULL(s.OrderStateIsDefault, 0) = 0)

sources.ref: DW10 database schema (INFORMATION_SCHEMA of a local DW10 install) and Dynamicweb.Ecommerce 10.29.8
